title: Cypress Rose | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* 4 Bikes Included * Great Outdoor Areas for Dining + Relaxing* Pet Friendly (Fees and Restrictions Apply; See Below)* Two Resort-style Pools, Infinity Pool (seasonally heated) overlooking the Gulf and Topsail State Park
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* 4 Bikes Included * Great Outdoor Areas for Dining + Relaxing* Pet Friendly (Fees and Restrictions Apply; See Below)* Two Resort-style Pools, Infinity Pool (seasonally heated) overlooking the Gulf and Topsail State Park * 1 mile to Beach Highlands Neighborhood Beach Access* Gated Community, Jetted Spa, Tennis courts, Nature trails, Fitness center, Outdoor Fireplace* Close to Stinky’s Fish Camp, Grand Blvd, and Gulf Place * Snorkel the Seahorse Reef- more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. * Welcome to Cypress Rose, nestled in the picturesque Cypress Dunes community, just off the scenic Hwy 30A. This stunning 5-bedroom, 5-bathroom home is the perfect retreat for those seeking the ultimate beach getaway. Its spacious layout is ideal for family gatherings, offering plenty of room to relax and entertain. On the first floor, you'll find a queen guest bedroom with an en suite, along with a guest bedroom featuring 2 twin bunk beds. The second floor boasts two queen guest bedrooms with en suites, providing added privacy and comfort. The third-floor Master Suite is a true retreat, complete with a luxurious king-sized bed, en suite, and balcony access, offering breathtaking views. With accommodations for up to 10 guests, Cypress Rose promises to be your new favorite vacation destination. Start your mornings with a coffee on the balcony and experience the beauty of this remarkable home.Along the west of 30A, just east of Miramar Beach, you’ll find the luxury gated community that is Cypress Dunes. Here begins the 18-mile bike path that stretches to Rosemary Beach. You will love neighborhood amenities here that include gulf views from the infinity-edged swimming pool (seasonally heated for spring and fall school breaks and the holidays), outdoor fireplace, large hot tub, fitness center, and a second-level sundeck overlooking the Gulf and Coastal Dunes Lake. Stroll along the wooden boardwalk and nature trails, have a picnic on the expansive recreational lawn area, or get your game on at the tennis courts. For luxury and convenience, Cypress Dunes truly has something for everyone!*Pet Fee is nonrefundable, $250/pet. Please note that we can accept requests for only one small dog. Pets are subject to approval - No Cats**Please note, this home has a maximum occupancy of 10 guests. 10 wristbands will be left inside the home at check-in. Each guest must wear a wristband at the Pool, Tennis Courts, and Clubhouse. Guests will be charged $100 for each lost wristband.*The Bed Setup: 1st Floor Guest Bedroom 1: Queen BedGuest Bedroom 2: 2 Twin/Twin Bunk Beds2nd Floor Guest Bedroom 3: Queen BedGuest Bedroom 4: Queen Bed3rd Floor:Master Bedroom: King Bed Area Attractions: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar-white sand and emerald-green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 715 feet out from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
